stage1.impression: A dark, brown-and-green lounge seen down its axis through a timber-framed opening, with two identical boxes at the far end glowing neon red. They read as lit signage or a nightclub display, not as tinted acrylic catching light. At 720 px it is soft and smeared by the denoiser. The surfaces are flat CG: the tiled back wall, the smooth booths, a blank black ceiling band and a near-black right third. The room is empty, with no glass, coat or record. A magazine would not run this as a specific place; it reads as a generic dark lounge render.

blocking_9: The frame must show what the card says it is for: the zinc counter with its fluted oak front and brass rail, the counter chairs, the Dome pendants hung low over the zinc, the back bar and record wall, with the altar at the end of the axis. At present none of the counter, Domes or record wall is legible.
The Ember pair must read as tinted cast acrylic lit by the room (spots on it, light through it, the white batts and horn legible), not as a red-outlined light box; no clipping on the cabinets.
Frame lum_median in 24 to 40, with the right third and the ceiling holding texture (median 14 or more), not black voids.
Visible life: glasses, the half-drunk coupe, a record out of its sleeve and a coat placed where the lens sees them.

Full-resolution delivery (2400 x 1600) with no denoiser smear on the concrete, oak and booth upholstery, and real board-formed concrete texture (tie holes, pour lines) instead of a tiled wall pattern.

defects.what: The frame does not show its subject: no zinc counter, no Dome pendants, no record wall or back bar visible; the view is through the partition opening into the banquette and altar zone
Left Ember reads as a neon-red outlined box or signage; the edges glow, clip_pct 0.52
Right Ember is the same neon-outline look, clip_pct 0.39; two identical glowing boxes read as a display
Back wall reads as a repeating tiled or mottled pattern rather than board-formed concrete; the dark speaker plinths are flat black slabs
Right third is a near-black void (median 7.9) with one stray blob reflection at about [645, 250]; there is no readable material
Ceiling band is a flat dead black strip (median 13.1), with no beams or grain visible
Left-edge marbled screen is cut by the frame edge and reads as a printed panel, an unexplained intrusion
Green booths are smooth CG upholstery with no seams or wear, crushed to a median of 15 in their lower half
Orb lamps bloom into soft blobs (p95 about 200) with no crystal or cup detail; they read as glowing balls
Foreground chairs are soft and have a plasticky, uniform oak finish; they are cut awkwardly at the frame edge
Proof at scale 0.3 is soft overall with denoiser smear; there are no props, so the room looks unoccupied

changes.problem: The frame misses its purpose: the counter, the Domes over the zinc, the counter chairs and the record wall are out of frame or unreadable, so the picture is of the banquette end and the altar.

evidence.measured: No zinc, brass rail, Dome or record wall is identifiable anywhere in the frame; the left foreground shows only chair backs at [0, 300, 230, 480]

change.to: position [3.0, 1.9, 1.35], target [17.0, 3.6, 1.15], 32 mm, f/4 focused at [9.0, 4.8, 1.1] (on the counter's midpoint). Keep verticals level and set so the counter's zinc edge runs along the left third and the altar sits just right of centre at the end of the axis

changes.expected: The counter, chairs, low Domes with their pools on the zinc and the record wall read on the left; the banquette and screens on the right; the Ember pair is small but clearly the end point and the only saturated colour.

changes.problem: The Ember cabinets read as neon-outlined signage because the per-speaker area lamps light the acrylic edges like a light box while the altar spots barely model the faces.

evidence.measured: r 103 / g 31 / b 31, p95 136, clip_pct 0.52 (right: clip 0.39); the edges glow, the faces are dark, the horn is grey

change.setting: on each Ember speaker area lamps; the altar spots
change.from: area 2.0 W/m2 at 2900 K; altar 2 x 90 W, cone 36 deg
change.to: area 0.8 W/m2 at 2900 K; altar 2 x 150 W, 2500 K, cone 28 deg, aimed at the cabinets' upper third from about 45 deg off axis so the light passes through the tint and lifts the white batts

changes.expected: Cabinets read as solid tinted acrylic with modelled faces and glowing polished edges, not outlines; no clipping on the cabinet.

changes.problem: The frame is a little under the night-interior range and most of it sits below 40.

change.to: 1.1 (keep AgX Medium High Contrast, white balance 3000 K)

changes.expected: Frame median about 27 to 32; shadows hold detail without lifting the lamps to clip.

changes.problem: The right third and the ceiling are black voids with no material, which flattens the room and hides the fir beams and concrete.

change.setting: haze density; screens' images; record wall spots
change.from: haze 0.01; screens 2.0; record wall 4 x 30 W cone 26
change.to: haze 0.025; screens 3.0; record wall 4 x 45 W, cone 32 deg, aimed to graze the wall and spill up onto the beams

changes.expected: The right wall and the beams pick up a soft warm graze; the planes separate in a faint atmosphere.

changes.problem: No sign of life in frame; the room looks like an unoccupied showroom.

evidence.measured: The table tops carry only the Orbs; no glass, record or coat is visible anywhere

change.from: glasses, coupe, record, coat placed out of the current view
change.to: the half-drunk coupe and two rocks glasses on the zinc in the nearest Dome pool; a record out of its sleeve on the counter by the turntable; the coat over the second counter chair in the near foreground; one glass on the nearest banquette table beside its Orb

changes.expected: Small highlights on glass in the pools of light; the room reads as in use.

changes.problem: The Dome downlights are the bar's key pools but do not register; the pools of light on the zinc are what make the frame cozy.

evidence.measured: Foreground median 42.7 with no pool shape; no Dome glow visible in frame

change.setting: the Domes' downlights; each Dome liner glow
change.from: 4 x 260 W, 2400 K, cone 30; liner glow 1.1
change.to: 4 x 260 W, 2400 K, cone 22 deg (tighter pools with dark gaps between); liner glow 0.8 so the smoked shells read as objects rather than blobs

changes.expected: Distinct warm ellipses on the zinc with darker zinc between them; the smoked Domes are legible against the record wall.

changes.problem: The concrete back wall reads as a tiled, mottled pattern and the upholstery as smooth CG; neither holds up at 1:1.

evidence.measured: Repeating mottled blocks across the wall at a regular pitch; booth faces [210, 290, 490, 420] are uniform, median 15, range 31 to 41

change.from: current concrete texture scale and sheen; smooth upholstery
change.to: Concrete: board-formed with 150 mm boards running horizontal, tie holes on a 600 x 600 grid, pour lines every 1.2 m, roughness 0.85, a slight warm stain variation, texture scale unique across the wall (no repeat within 4 m). Upholstery: a wool-velvet normal/roughness with piping seams and slight sag on the seat fronts, sheen 0.3

changes.expected: The wall reads as real concrete with formwork grain under warm light; the booths read as upholstered.

changes.problem: The proof's resolution and denoiser smear make everything soft and CG.

evidence.measured: Chair grain and edges are smeared at 3x crop; frame is 720 x 480 (scale 0.3)

change.to: full 2400 x 1600, 512 samples, adaptive 0.01, denoise on, clamp 10

changes.expected: Crisp oak grain, steel edges and acrylic edges; no smear in the shadows.

out_of_scope.request: Show one Ember instead of two identical red cabinets, since a pair of identical glowing boxes reads as a display.
out_of_scope.why: The card fixes the Ember pair on the altar; the lighting change in c2 is the in-scope remedy.

out_of_scope.request: Reduce the saturation of the bottle-green booths so the speaker is the only saturated colour.
out_of_scope.why: The zone and its colour are fixed by the room's design.

out_of_scope.request: Remove or move the marbled screen cut by the left frame edge.
out_of_scope.why: The screens and what they show are fixed; the reframe in c1 should place it in a deliberate position.
